title: working on first-person psychological horror game
author: Many-Yesterday3768
selftext:
I'm making TWO-FIFTEEN, a first-person psychological horror game set in one house, over one night. It's made in Unity.

The AI parts of my workflow:

Cutscenes : there's no mocap and no hand keyframing. Every cutscene is a Python script for Blender that I write together with Claude: character paths, where they look, hand reaches, cameras, lights. Change a line, rebuild the scene, render.

Voices : all dialogue is ElevenLabs v3. The subtitles are timed automatically from the recordings.

The game design, the story and the in-game work are mine.

Steam page: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5309090/TwoFifteen](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5309090/TwoFifteen)
